datasets: 60 LLM-generated test QA pairs (Claude Sonnet 4.6) on Indonesian academic guideline documents and structured student data
key_result: The system successfully answered 58 out of 60 queries, achieving a ROUGE-L f1-score of 0.29.

datasets: Jambi culture corpus; 130 in-domain + 50 out-of-context test queries
models: Qwen2.5-7B; BM25; dense retriever (unnamed); RRF; BGE-Reranker-Large; Confidence Scorer
key_result: Dense RAG performed most dominantly end-to-end, achieving the highest Pure Recall@10 (0.992), BLEU-1 (0.499), ROUGE-L (0.506), Groundedness (0.611), and lowest False Rejection Rate (11.5%).
notes: Journal page gave abstract only. Local execution and hardware not stated; language not stated (presumably Indonesian). Abstract says Hybrid Final Recall/BLEU-4 'on par with Dense' but gives no Dense values; Hybrid FRR not given. Abstract headline (Hybrid mitigates hallucination) vs finding that Dense is most robust is mildly in tension.

datasets: Synthetic Thai marketer briefs with KOL profiles; end-to-end Set 1 (11 queries, 50 candidates labeled) and Set 2 (31 queries, top 10 labeled); 41 T10 best-pick triplets
models: Qwen3.5-4B (SimPO LoRA reranker; untuned base reasoner); dense retriever (embedding model unnamed); Kimi-K2.6 frontier baseline; DeepSeek-V3.2 (data generation)
key_result: On Set 1 the rerank-then-base-reason cascade reaches 94.1% P@5 versus 54.5% for retrieval-only (random 54.0%) and 91.8% for rerank-then-Kimi-K2.6 (think), with about 35x fewer output tokens.
notes: Full text read (arXiv HTML). Inconsistencies: Table 7 test-set n varies (259, 250, 244, 254) for the same set without explanation; 'SFT++GRPO' vs 'SFT+GRPO' naming; abstract says top-10 reasoning 'halves' tokens but Table 10 gives ~420k vs ~797k (about 47%). Embedding model not named; code/data release not stated. Very small eval sets (11 and 31 queries). Domain is influencer search, only loosely RAG.

models: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 + FAISS IVF-PQ retrieval; OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct (frozen, 4-bit NF4); ~7M-parameter MLP selector

Text says HS 'consistently improves' but HS+RW on TriviaQA (44.95) is below the rank baseline (44.96). Single LLM annotator, no human validation; no limitations section; code release not stated. Page metadata lists journal as 'Nuclear Physics B', which looks wrong.

datasets: SQuAD v1.1; MS MARCO v2.1; Natural Questions (500-query stratified samples for hallucination judging)
models: BM25 + BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 (LangChain EnsembleRetriever, 30/70 sparse/dense); Llama 3.2 via Ollama; Gemini API (offline judge only)
hardware: AMD Ryzen 12-core, NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop 6GB VRAM, 32GB DDR5, Windows 11
key_result: With the 30/70 hybrid, SQuAD reaches MRR 0.805, Recall@10 0.974 and a 0.8% hallucination rate, with median single-user latency of 2.0 s (6.8 s with 10 concurrent users).
notes: Full text read. Inconsistencies: text claims hybrid consistently beats single methods but Table 2 shows dense MRR 0.315 > hybrid 0.250 on MS MARCO and equal MRR on SQuAD; Table 5 success for MS MARCO is 96.8% though 1 - 6.2% = 93.8%; 'over 1,500' judged pairs vs 1,000 reported (NQ judging pending); inter-judge agreement is really same-judge self-consistency (temp 0 vs 0.2); Wang et al. 2024 citation ambiguity. System is fully local, but evaluation uses Gemini API for judging. Code on GitHub (commit cited). Abstention not implemented.

datasets: 108 English questions (54 answerable, 54 unanswerable) on one Kverneland fertilizer-spreader manual in six language editions; ISO 11783 transfer benchmarks
models: GPT-OSS 120B, Gemma 3 12B, Qwen 3 8B, DeepSeek-R1 8B, Qwen 2.5 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, Llama 3.2 3B, DeepSeek-R1 1.5B (Ollama, 4-bit); Qwen3-Embedding-8B + BM25 with RRF; GPT-OSS 20B judge
hardware: PC-grade hardware (GPU not identified in text read); CAN bus 250 kbit/s transfer rig; embeddings on CPU
key_result: On the English manual in Markdown, F1 ranged from 0.54 (DeepSeek-R1 1.5B) to 0.83 (Qwen 2.5 7B), GPT-OSS 120B scoring 0.81, and a complete manual transferred over ISO 11783 in 31 to 89 s.
notes: Full text read except last ~20k characters. arXiv preprint (venue in CSV) though page states acceptance in Computers and Electronics in Agriculture 2026, so coded no per venue field. Inconsistencies: 31 s lower transfer bound is not attributed in visible Markdown numbers (47-55 s); Sec 7.1 says JSON had lowest F1 for most models but Sec 6.3 reports most format differences as not significant. Judge validated vs humans (93.5% agreement, kappa 0.87). One manual, one run per config; security out of scope. Code/data at TUMAMX/agriquery.
